verdict.rationale: LibreChat documents multiple one-command self-host paths (Docker Compose as the recommended simple method, npm, and Helm chart) explicitly for local installs, and community testimony corroborates that installation is quick and easy ('Just installed this... quite easy'). Missing for 10: a first-party benchmark or docs claim of exact 'minutes to first chat' timing, and no independent verification specifically of the Docker Compose one-command flow.
